Appointments, advice and follow-up care were always handled with kindness and reassurance, which made a challenging situation far easier for our family to navigate.

Addition to my original positive review 6 months later**

Called the surgery to request an emergency appointment with a GP…. As I was in need of immediate help that day!
I received a text promptly back telling me to wait until my next appointment which I had booked for a completely unrelated matter. The waiting time on this originally booked appointment was 6 WEEKS!!
One of the most intimidating aspects of this service is having to share private information with the call handlers, of which on my first call I was reluctant to share but shared all I felt comfortable with.
I received a text message from a duty doctor telling me to wait until my next appointment.  I then called back and gave the “gatekeeper” every bit of possible information I could in the hope that I would get an appointment… still no. You must wait for a phone call. So I waited, and waited and waited.

By the time I did receive a phone call I had already been admitted to the cardiology unit at Worcester Hospital.

It’s so disappointing to have to go through this process when I was a genuine patient in need. It makes having to go to the doctors or even calling them an anxiety trip that doesn’t need to happen.
The initial process of sharing information to be communicated to a GP needs to change, because if the info isn’t powerful enough then you aren’t going to get the help.

I am grateful to have a surgery as stated below, however the service is progressively getting worse which makes it very difficult to continue to be patient and polite to those at the surgery just trying to do their job.
People want to be treated with respect but how can you show respect when you’re treated so poorly?

I’ve been a patient here for 6 years. Firstly, I’ve never had to wait excessive amounts of time. The surgery staff have always been friendly and respectful (to those who show respect and deserve it).
I had an appointment today and I realised how glad I was to have such an excellent and understanding service. I have a hidden illness, but it’s never felt like it’s not seen by the professionals.
Thank you for all your help.",null,[0,141]]]],[],[null,null,null,["https://www.google.com/maps/reviews/data=!4m8!14m7!1m6!2m5!1sCi9DQUlRQUNvZENodHljRjlvT2pOMVRXUlZlVEpVVG5wT2RIZElRamhqYkhJeE5HYxAB!2m1!1s0x0:0x4601b3603d15f6eb!3m1!1s2@1:CAIQACodChtycF9oOjN1TWRVeTJUTnpOdHdIQjhjbHIxNGc%7C%7C?hl=en"],["https://www.google.com/local/content/rap/report?postId=Ci9DQUlRQUNvZENodHljRjlvT2pOMVRXUlZlVEpVVG5wT2RIZElRamhqYkhJeE5HYxAB&t=1&&wv=1&d=286732320",null,null,"0ahUKEwin9OfkybKTAxXyTIQGHbV_Mp0QoykIDSgB"],null,[null,[[1,0]]]],"0ahUKEwin9OfkybKTAxXyTIQGHbV_Mp0Q0pMFCAsoAw"],null,"CAESY0NBRVFCQnBFUTJwRlNVRlNTWEJEWjI5QlVEY3lSMDVTTFd3M1ZWOWZSV2hDZUVSVFdFRk9SamhpU1hoTGNXaDZaMEZCUVVGQlIyZHVPVEpSTkVOWk1VZzJXSFJSV1VGRFNVRQ=="],[["ChdDSUhNMG9nS0VJQ0FnSUNyMUt5cXBnRRAB",["0x0:0x4601b3603d15f6eb",null,1720087933388328,1767779639568996,[null,null,["https://www.google.com/maps/contrib/117483100394404275188/reviews?hl=en"],null,null,["Motson","https://lh3.googleusercontent.com/a-/ALV-UjV6MGCcSHuYYqGOSWzlfV80IJSaov631fuIFLzgF29QOfXEIsI=s120-c-rp-mo-br100",["https://www.google.com/maps/contrib/117483100394404275188?hl=en"],"117483100394404275188",null,1,0,null,[0,3,1],0,["1 review",null,null,null,null,[null,"0ahUKEwin9OfkybKTAxXyTIQGHbV_Mp0Q7LoGCA8oAA"]]]],null,"Edited 2 months ago",null,null,null,null,null,null,["Google","https://www.gstatic.com/images/branding/product/1x/googleg_48dp.png",null,null,5],null,1],[[1],null,null,null,null,null,null,null,null,null,null,null,null,null,["en"],[["The patient care navigators I communicated with exhibited an extremely discourteous and patronizing demeanor, and they severely lacked compassion - which leads me to wonder why they chose to pursue this profession?
